description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Drain Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Drain Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Drain Blade 1/2/3 after using two Dark abilities if the user's HP% is 100/80/0%

description.name: Drain Blade 1
description.text: Four single attacks (0.76 each), causes [ATK and MAG -50% (8s)], grants [ATK and MAG +50% (8s)] and [Physical High Quick Cast 2] to the user, 100% hit rate

description.name: Physical High Quick Cast 2
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 for PHY attacks

description.name: Drain Blade 2
description.text: Four single attacks (0.76 each), heals the user for 20% of the damage dealt, grants [Physical Quick Cast 2] to the user, 100% hit rate

description.name: Physical Quick Cast 2
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for PHY attacks

description.name: Drain Blade 3
description.text: Four single attacks (0.76 each), heals the user for 20% of the damage dealt
